Proceed with the three “Next Commands” in order; they cover (1) module-level A/B selection, (2) system-level candidates, and (3) an auto-generated “next fix” report.

## 1) Run module autopilot (select best)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
What to watch for:
- Any errors loading the registry or missing modules.
- Whether a new “best” module version is promoted/selected.
- Result deltas vs the current champion (you’ll want mean and min improvements, plus any regressions).

## 2) Run system autopilot (system candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
What to watch for:
- Whether any system candidates beat `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` on your primary metric(s) (tuning_mean/min, lockbox_mean/min).
- If any candidate improves mean but harms min (or vice versa), note it for follow-up constraints.

## 3) Generate next-fix recommendations
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
What to do with it:
- Open `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` and use it to pick the next targeted fix/experiment, especially if system autopilot didn’t produce a clear winner.

## After you run them
Paste back:
- The console summaries from steps (1) and (2)
- The top section (or findings) from `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`

…and I’ll help interpret results, decide whether to promote a new champion, and propose the next concrete experiment.
